verdict.rationale: Okta is an identity and access management platform, not a tool-using agent. Consuming tools from plugged-in MCP servers is the MCP-client role, which is a category error for this product type. The evidence shows only that Okta publishes its own MCP server and secures agent-to-app access through Cross App Access. Both are server-side or identity capabilities, so they do not make the client axis applicable.
